intervalSeconds.help: How long each prayer or reflection stays on screen.

textScale.help: Adjusts quote size while still fitting inside the screen.

textOpacity.help: Controls how strongly the quote appears over the background.

showMetadata.help: Shows optional title and source metadata from the active prayers.

localLibraryJson.help: Paste a JSON array or {"prayers": [...]} export, then click Apply prayers JSON. The in-wallpaper editor is friendlier for everyday edits.
localLibraryJson.value: {"version":1,"prayers":[{"lines":["لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ","لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ","لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيم"],"title":"دعاء الكرب","lang":"ar","dir":"rtl"},{"lines":["God grant me the serenity","to accept the things I cannot change;","courage to change the things I can;","and wisdom to know the difference."],"title":"Serenity Prayer","lang":"en","dir":"ltr"},{"lines":["لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِ ۖ","وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ","فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ ۚ","لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا ۚ","سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا (7)"],"title":"سورة الطلاق","lang":"ar","dir":"rtl"}]}

applyLocalLibraryJson.help: Replace the saved local library with the JSON above.

resetLocalLibraryJson.help: Replace the saved local library with the packaged quotes.json defaults.

themeMode.help: Choose a dark wallpaper, a light wallpaper, or follow the system color scheme.

backgroundMotion.help: Controls how quickly the background spectrum drifts.

paletteIntensity.help: Controls the strength of the muted color spectrum.

backgroundBrightness.help: Lower values keep the wallpaper darker.

particleDensity.help: Controls the number of quiet light particles in the background.

particleGlow.help: Controls how softly the particles illuminate the background.

enableAnimation.help: Turns background and text motion on or off.
